name: Holoray Project
tagline: Draw annotations on medical video and they stay attached to the anatomy as it moves.

awards: Anchored Insight: Motion-Tracked Annotations for Live Medical Video by HoloRay

problem: The sponsor's challenge: annotations on live medical video must track moving features with low latency.
solution: OpenCV tracking keeps polygons and freehand lines locked to features as the video plays, with arrows and text, in a Flask interface.
demo_moment: Team-described: draw around a feature and watch the outline follow it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Anchored Insight: Motion-Tracked Annotations for Live Medical Video by HoloRay” among 127 submissions.
Tuned the speed–accuracy trade-off of tracking.
Won a challenge many teams entered (see the roster).

lessons: In a crowded sponsor challenge, tracking quality on the sponsor's footage decides it.
